name: Masonry

columns.description: Column count at the widest breakpoint.

minColumn.description: Minimum column width; the browser narrows the column count to fit it.

reveal.description: Fade-and-rise each item once as it scrolls into view.

stagger.description: Delay between each revealed item, in ms — by intersection order, not DOM index.

hoverLift.description: Lift the hovered or focused item slightly.

a11y: Reading order is DOM order, which matches the visual column order.
Items that are links keep a visible :focus-visible ring; the hover/focus lift transform does not clip it.
Captions are real text and stay in the DOM at every breakpoint.
